title: Trend Reactor
pitch: Build a pipeline that watches Reddit, Twitter and YouTube in real time with Agent-Reach's zero-API-fee social search, spots a breaking story or viral moment within minutes, and immediately generates a 30-60 second explainer or reaction video with LongCat-Video's text-to-video model, fully captioned and branded. Sell it as a subscription tool to solo news/explainer YouTubers and social-media managers who need to post reactive content same-day but don't have a camera crew or hours to spare editing footage that doesn't exist yet.
why_now: Both repos trended today for solving the two hardest parts of fast reactive video content: Agent-Reach removes the cost and hassle of tracking what's trending across platforms, and LongCat-Video removes the need for real footage entirely. Combined, they collapse 'something just went viral' to 'a posted video' down to minutes instead of hours.
